# Kishore Reddy Pagidi — kishorepagidi.com

> AI Product Manager at SOLIDWORKS. CAD agents, design automation, and robotics. Building AI for engineering workflows.

## Who I am

Kishore Reddy Pagidi is an AI Product Manager at SOLIDWORKS (Dassault Systèmes), working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, CAD software, robotics, and engineering workflows. His work includes the Vibe CADing vision for conversational, intent-driven, AI-assisted CAD design.

## Primary niche

AI product management for engineering and CAD software. Specifically: how large language models, vision models, and agentic AI systems transform how engineers design, model, manufacture, and validate physical products.

The surface area he works on:
- Parametric part generation from natural language
- CAD model edits via conversational AI
- Automated engineering drawing creation
- Design validation and manufacturability analysis
- CAD agent frameworks and skill systems

## Selected experience

1. Developed the Vibe CADing vision for conversational, AI-assisted CAD workflows.
2. AI PM at SOLIDWORKS, a professional CAD platform with a community of 8M+ engineers, designers, students, makers, and industry professionals.
3. Co-inventor on 4 published UK patent applications in vehicle safety: GB2627443A, GB2626533A, GB2629203A, and GB2634078A. These are application publications, not a claim of granted patents.
4. Published robotics research at CoRL 2023 (Conference on Robot Learning).
5. Conference speaker at 3DEXPERIENCE World 2025 and 2026. The 2025 sessions covered Cloud Services and cloud-based PLM; the 2026 co-presented sessions covered AI-assisted design and AURA.
6. MS-level research in robotic manipulation and skill transfer.
7. 200+ CAD AI use cases mapped, evaluated, and prioritized.

## What "Vibe CADing" means

Vibe CADing is the idea that CAD — computer-aided design — is becoming conversational. Instead of building 3D models through manual feature trees, constraint systems, and sketch operations, engineers will design by describing intent in natural language. The CAD system understands geometry, design history, manufacturing constraints, and produces editable, parametric models.

Kishore developed vision videos at SOLIDWORKS exploring conversational, AI-assisted CAD workflows.

## Career context

The SOLIDWORKS community has over 8 million members, including engineers, designers, students, makers, and industry professionals. This is platform context, not measured reach of Kishore’s work. Kishore works on the AI product strategy for this platform — deciding which AI capabilities to build, validating them with customers, and shipping them as product features. He runs the AI Customer Advisory Board and maintains ongoing relationships with engineers building physical products.
